title: ONEM1ND 1.0
note: The whole ONEM1ND 1.0 flow in ten rows. Built screens are photographs of the candidate; "Approved, not built" are the approved key moments; "Proposed" are drawn from the plan and need approval.

objects.name: Row 1: Install and first open
objects.value: 1. Install and first open

objects.name: Note: Install, the folder does not exist
objects.value: Built. The one install screen. The line under the folder says what will happen: "The folder will be created."

objects.name: Note: Install, a folder without a M1ND
objects.value: Built. The folder exists and holds no M1ND: "The M1ND files will be created in this folder."

objects.name: Note: Install, a folder with a M1ND
objects.value: Built. A M1ND of this version is already there: "This computer will join the M1ND in this folder."

objects.name: Note: Install, an older M1ND is refused
objects.value: Built. A folder with an older M1ND cannot be used. Install stays off. The Overseer brings older minds in after the first open (row 9).

objects.name: Note: Install, in progress
objects.value: Built. Step 2 of 2. The app opens by itself when the service is up.

objects.name: Note: Install, the service did not start
objects.value: Built. Error state with Retry. Setup resumes from this step.

objects.name: Note: First open, agent for the Overseer
objects.value: Approved, not built. The only choice before writing. The agents listed are the ones found on the computer. Accounts and repositories are offered in the conversation afterwards.

objects.name: Row 2: The Overseer conversation and offers
objects.value: 2. The Overseer conversation and offers

objects.name: Note: The Overseer offers the rest
objects.value: Approved, not built. What used to be windows at first open is offered in the conversation, when it applies. One main action, Choose, Not now.

objects.name: Note: Built from a request
objects.value: Approved, not built. The Overseer answers a request by creating conversations. They appear on the canvas, connected.

objects.name: Note: A long conversation, earlier messages loading
objects.value: Built. Message bubbles name the sender. Scrolling up to the top loads the earlier messages; there is no button.

objects.name: Row 3: The shell and the canvas
objects.value: 3. The shell and the canvas

objects.name: Note: Reading the M1ND
objects.value: Built. Loading state while the first read is open.

objects.name: Note: The M1ND cannot be read
objects.value: Built. Error state with Retry and Choose another folder.

objects.name: Note: A new M1ND, nothing on the canvas
objects.value: Built. Empty state. Services that are not set up are rows in the list; the canvas says how to add the first card.

objects.name: Note: The shell: list, conversation, canvas
objects.value: Built. Three columns. Near cards are 196x88 with their connections, a repository card and a note, on the dot ground. The zoom bar holds minus, the percentage, plus and Fit.

objects.name: Note: The bar menu
objects.value: Built. The Map bar holds the modes, the phone and the menu. Waiting, Activity and Settings are in the menu. There is no Add on the Map.

objects.name: Note: Zoomed out, circles
objects.value: Built. Below 70% each card becomes a circle with its name under it.

objects.name: Note: The service is not answering
objects.value: Built. Banner with Retry now while the app reconnects. Actions are kept and sent when the service answers.

objects.name: Note: A card under the pointer
objects.value: Approved, not built. The border lights and the actions appear above the card. The rings on its edges start a connection. The drawing still shows Pause, which is hidden in 1.0 (next screen).

objects.name: Note: A card under the pointer, Pause hidden
objects.value: Proposed. Same screen without Pause, as task 072 decided for this build. Plan: task 072 answers: Pause is hidden on canvas cards in this build; plan.md B10.

objects.name: Note: Right-click on the canvas
objects.value: Approved, not built. The list opens at the pointer. What is chosen is created at that point.

objects.name: Note: Moving a card
objects.value: Approved, not built. The card rises while held and the place it left stays marked. Connections follow it. It settles exactly where it is dropped.

objects.name: Note: Connecting two cards
objects.value: Approved, not built. Dragging from a ring draws a connection that follows the pointer; a card that can take it lights up.

objects.name: Note: Connections, near
objects.value: Approved, not built. How a connection attaches at every angle between two cards: the side that faces the other card, spread along it, clear of other cards.

objects.name: Note: Connections, far
objects.value: Approved, not built. The same rules for circles and for several connections on one card.

objects.name: Note: Select and group
objects.value: Approved, not built. Dragging over the empty canvas selects several cards. Group draws a named frame; Message writes to all of them.

objects.name: Row 4: Conversations, new conversation and permissions
objects.value: 4. Conversations, new conversation and permissions

objects.name: Note: New conversation
objects.value: Approved, not built. Three choices, each with a default: Role, Agent, Works in.

objects.name: Note: New conversation, Role open
objects.value: Approved, not built. The list of role templates opens under its field, inside the window.

objects.name: Note: A conversation with an agent, as built
objects.value: Built. A click on a card or a list row opens that conversation in the middle column. Tabs: Chat, Work, Details.

objects.name: Note: A permission request, as built today
objects.value: Built. Approve, Always for this agent and Deny as three buttons. The approved card replaces this (two screens ahead).

objects.name: Note: Waiting on the person, as built
objects.value: Built. The Waiting list opened from the bar menu.

objects.name: Note: A permission request
objects.value: Approved, not built. One card with one main action. "Always" is an option, not a third button. The count shows in the bar, the list row and the card.

objects.name: Row 5: Blueprint
objects.value: 5. Blueprint

objects.name: Note: Blueprint, opening
objects.value: Built. Blueprint is the web app inside the shell. While it opens, the shell shows this state. The app itself is not drawn here: it is a separate product in the desktop host.

objects.name: Note: Blueprint, could not be opened
objects.value: Built. Error state with Retry. Blueprint needs the internet the first time.

objects.name: Row 6: Void
objects.value: 6. Void

objects.name: Note: Void, opening
objects.value: Built. Void is the web app inside the shell, like Blueprint. The app itself is not drawn here.

objects.name: Note: Void, could not be opened
objects.value: Built. Error state with Retry.

objects.name: Row 7: Settings and the service
objects.value: 7. Settings and the service

objects.name: Note: Settings, Agents and accounts
objects.value: Approved, not built. Sections on the left, named by what is done in them. One line per row. Service state, versions and sync folders move to Advanced.

objects.name: Note: Settings, General, as built today
objects.value: Built. Look, language, the Relay service and the phone link. Reached from the bar menu.

objects.name: Note: Settings, Agents, as built today
objects.value: Built. Clients on this computer, each with its state and the changes it needs.

objects.name: Note: Settings, review of the changes for a client
objects.value: Built. Nothing is written until the changes are applied; they can also be copied.

objects.name: Note: Settings, Projects, as built today
objects.value: Built. Linked folders.

objects.name: Note: Settings, Content, as built today
objects.value: Built. Features, knowledge packs and preferences.

objects.name: Row 8: The member network and joining
objects.value: 8. The member network and joining

objects.name: Note: Join offer
objects.value: Proposed. On the new computer, after Start, the Overseer offers to join a M1ND found on the network.

objects.name: Note: Waiting for permission
objects.value: Proposed. The request waits on the other computer. No key or history is shared before an answer.

objects.name: Note: The request on the member that is asked
objects.value: Proposed. On the existing member the request is a card in the Overseer conversation, with 1 waiting in the bar. Approve or Decline.

objects.name: Note: Approved, bringing in the M1ND
objects.value: Proposed. Only approval releases the key and the history.

objects.name: Note: Joined
objects.value: Proposed. The conversations and the canvas are the same as on the other computer.

objects.name: Note: Declined
objects.value: Proposed. Shown on the asking computer.

objects.name: Note: Cancelled on the asking computer
objects.value: Proposed. The asking computer withdrew the request.

objects.name: Note: Request withdrawn, shown on the member
objects.value: Proposed. The card disappears from the member and leaves one line.

objects.name: Note: Bringing in stopped, Retry
objects.value: Proposed. Error state with Retry. What was brought in is kept.

objects.name: Note: Settings, Folder and devices, no other computer
objects.value: Proposed. Empty state of the member list.

objects.name: Note: Settings, Folder and devices, request pending
objects.value: Proposed. The same request, answered from Settings.

objects.name: Note: Settings, Folder and devices
objects.value: Proposed. One list of computers, with the state of each, and the folder with Change.

objects.name: Row 9: Bringing in old minds
objects.value: 9. Bringing in old minds

objects.name: Note: The Overseer offers to bring in old minds
objects.value: Proposed. After the agent choice. What was found, with sizes and counts. Nothing is read in depth or written before the yes.

objects.name: Note: Choosing what to bring in
objects.value: Proposed. Same card pattern as the repositories offer.

objects.name: Note: Bringing in, progress
objects.value: Proposed. An agent task. The originals are only read, never changed. Secrets are never read.

objects.name: Note: Brought in, index and report
objects.value: Proposed. The index says what was brought in and from where. The report says what was left out and why.

objects.name: Note: Bringing in stopped, Retry
objects.value: Proposed. Resumable. An interrupted run leaves the index consistent.

objects.name: Note: A second run, nothing new
objects.value: Proposed. A second run brings in only what is new.

objects.name: Row 10: The phone
objects.value: 10. The phone

objects.name: Note: Phone, pairing
objects.value: Built. A code typed from Settings, Open on the phone, or a QR code.

objects.name: Note: Phone, the code does not match
objects.value: Built. Error state. The tries left are shown.

objects.name: Note: Phone, pairing locked
objects.value: Built. Five codes did not match. Pairing stays locked for 10 minutes; a new code from the computer unlocks it at once.

objects.name: Note: Phone, Hierarchy
objects.value: Built. The Overseer, the clusters and the services, with the count that waits. The Map is not on the phone.

objects.name: Note: Phone, a conversation
objects.value: Built. Messages, a permission to approve or deny, and a task to accept or send back.

objects.name: Note: Phone, waiting on the person
objects.value: Built. Asks and reviews that wait on the person. Standing approvals and pushes are answered on the computer.

objects.name: Note: Phone, access ended
objects.value: Built. Phone access lasts 12 hours. A new code from the computer opens it again.
